name: Why do garage door quotes vary so much from one company to another?

mainEntity.name: Why do garage door quotes vary so much from one company to another?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro, a standard replacement usually fits within common pricing ranges, but custom sizes, premium materials, and weather-resistant glass doors can raise the total quickly. Homes that need extra structural adjustments, upgraded hardware, or a new opener will also cost more. The safest way to compare quotes is to make sure each one includes the same scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quotes vary because of door material, insulation, size, hardware, opener work, and how much adjustment the opening needs.
